items.title: RazorpayX Payout Issues Highlight Risks in Digital Payment Security
items.snippet: Fears over digital payment security have been stoked by RazorpayX payments problems due to delays tied to technical improvements at its banking partner. As it prioritised service restoration, Razorpay informed merchants that their monies were safe and fully accounted for.

items.title: RBI Plans ‘Stop Switch’ to Prevent Digital Payment Frauds
items.snippet: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has recommended a ‘Stop Switch’ to enable users to halt outbound digital payments and combat online fraud. The proposed rules also contain an optional Trusted Person Mechanism for large value transactions that require extra approval.

items.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Amid Trump Pressure
items.snippet: US President Donald Trump, shareholders and employees pressured Nvidia to reinstall co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, president and board director beginning November 23. Facing the heat from the issue and tumbling stock prices, the board reversed its decision to oust Huang.
